title: Title & Registration Services Schedule of Document Acceptance Standards by Service Type
content:
Each Title & Registration Services service type fixes which of the buyer's documents must be received in acceptable form before the order is ready to submit, which of them the state accepts only as wet-ink originals, which may arrive as a scan or photo, and the content tests a document has to pass. The figures below apply to every order of the named service type.

## A. Required documents

| Service type | Documents that must be received in acceptable form |
|---|---|
| Kestrel Title-Only Service | signed power of attorney; odometer disclosure |
| Kestrel In-State Plate Transfer | signed power of attorney; odometer disclosure; proof of residence; proof of insurance; prior plate registration |
| Kestrel In-State New Registration | signed power of attorney; odometer disclosure; proof of residence; proof of insurance |
| Kestrel Out-of-State Registration | signed power of attorney; odometer disclosure; proof of residence; proof of insurance |
| Kestrel Out-of-State Registration with Inspection | signed power of attorney; odometer disclosure; proof of residence; proof of insurance; VIN inspection form; emissions certificate |
| Kestrel Specialty Plate Registration | signed power of attorney; odometer disclosure; proof of residence; proof of insurance; specialty plate application |

## B. Form of the document

| Service type | Accepted only as a wet-ink original | May be accepted as a scan or photo |
|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Title-Only Service | signed power of attorney | proof of residence, proof of insurance, emissions certificate, VIN inspection form, prior plate registration |
| Kestrel In-State Plate Transfer | none | proof of residence, proof of insurance, emissions certificate, VIN inspection form, prior plate registration |
| Kestrel In-State New Registration | none | proof of residence, proof of insurance, emissions certificate, VIN inspection form, prior plate registration |
| Kestrel Out-of-State Registration | signed power of attorney; odometer disclosure | proof of residence, proof of insurance, emissions certificate, VIN inspection form, prior plate registration |
| Kestrel Out-of-State Registration with Inspection | signed power of attorney; odometer disclosure | proof of residence, proof of insurance, emissions certificate, VIN inspection form, prior plate registration |
| Kestrel Specialty Plate Registration | specialty plate application | proof of residence, proof of insurance, emissions certificate, VIN inspection form, prior plate registration |

A document that a service lists in neither column may be e-signed or a wet-ink original.

## C. Content tests

| Service type | Maximum age of a proof of residence (days) | Proof of insurance must show the purchased VIN | Model age at or above which no odometer disclosure is required (years) | Transferred plate must be registered to the buyer named on the agreement | Registration states where the signed power of attorney must be notarized |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Title-Only Service | 60 | Yes | 20 | No | OH, PA |
| Kestrel In-State Plate Transfer | 60 | Yes | 20 | Yes | OH, PA |
| Kestrel In-State New Registration | 60 | Yes | 20 | No | OH, PA |
| Kestrel Out-of-State Registration | 60 | Yes | 20 | No | OH, PA |
| Kestrel Out-of-State Registration with Inspection | 60 | Yes | 20 | No | OH, PA |
| Kestrel Specialty Plate Registration | 60 | Yes | 20 | No | OH, PA |

The age of a proof of residence (a utility bill, lease or bank statement) is counted from its statement date to the date it was received.

## Reading the schedule

- The wet-ink column and the scan column never name the same document for one service type, so each document of a service has exactly one permitted set of forms.
- Hypothetical illustration: under Kestrel In-State New Registration a prior plate registration is not a required document, while under Kestrel In-State Plate Transfer it is required and must show the plate registered to the buyer.
- Hypothetical illustration: a signed power of attorney returned as a scan is acceptable in form for Kestrel In-State Plate Transfer, but not for Kestrel Title-Only Service, where only a wet-ink original counts.
